mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for August 5, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Mass funeral held in Gaza for victims of 2023 Israeli strike. Remains of 112 victims, including 40 children, recovered from rubble more than two years after the residential block was destroyed. This was reported by The Guardian and BBC News. For the full source-backed dispatch, read the August 5, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
